value.name: Marylin calls Miles distressed
value.description: Marylin reaches Miles by phone and begins the conversation in an emotionally unstable state.

value.name: Marylin expresses self-loathing
value.description: Marylin says she is worthless, nothing, and undeserving of life, revealing severe self-hatred.
evidence: You're right about me. I am worthless. I am nothing. I don't deserve to live.

value.name: Marylin blames others for betraying her
value.description: Marylin says she does not blame Rex, Howard, or her father for betraying her, framing herself as the cause of her misery.
evidence: I don't blame them for betraying me. I don't blame Rex, or Howard or my father.

value.name: Marylin drives erratically and shouts at another driver
value.description: Tire screeching is heard as Marylin angrily yells at someone while apparently driving.
evidence: We hear the SCREECH of Tires.
MARYLIN (yelling at someone) Screw you, asswipe!

value.name: Miles suspects Marylin is drunk
value.description: Miles notices Marylin's behavior and asks whether she is drunk.
evidence: Forgive me but are you -- drunk?

value.name: Marylin continues road rage
value.description: Marylin keeps yelling at another motorist, confirming she is still driving unsafely.
evidence: (Scream) You get out of the car. That's right, Fuctard. I'm talkin' to you!

value.name: Miles warns Marylin not to drive
value.description: Miles tells Marylin she should not be driving and asks where she is.
evidence: You shouldn't be driving. Where are you?

value.name: Marylin reveals her location on Sunset
value.description: Marylin says she is on Sunset near the Beverly Hills Hotel and suggests meeting for a drink.
evidence: I'm on Sunset. Near the Beverly Hills hotel. Wanna meet me for a drink in the Polo...?
value.location_hint: Sunset near the Beverly Hills Hotel

value.name: Miles invites Marylin to his place
value.description: Miles says he lives nearby and tells Marylin to come to his place immediately.
evidence: I live right near there. The Block of Maple. Come here. Marylin -- come here right now before -- just come here.

value.name: Miles forbids Marylin to stop for coffee
value.description: When Marylin asks about stopping at Starbucks, Miles urgently tells her not to stop and keep driving to him.
evidence: Should I stop at Starbucks and pick up a blended for --

value.name: Marylin agrees to come to Miles
value.description: Marylin accepts Miles's instructions and ends the exchange by agreeing to head over.
